newsitem.title: USA: Goldman strategist shifting bullish stance - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Goldman strategist shifting bullish stance - WSJ.

text.p: Goldman Sachs strategist Abby Cohen has adjusted her bullish stance and told her clients that the U.S. stock market may be heading into "a trading range," the Wall Street Journal said Thursday.
The paper reported in its "Heard on the Street" column that Cohen, who is known for her bullish stance on U.S. stocks, has been calling the market "modestly overvalued" in recent weeks.
She told the paper however that she is not turning bearish.
"We think we are still in a bull market," the report quoted her as saying. "It's not a change of view. We're just saying we don't expect the market to move up."
